title: Majority noise stability bound
statement: There is a constant $C>0$ such that, for every natural number $m$ and every $0<\rho<1$, the noise stability at correlation $\rho$ of majority on $2m+1$ independent signs is at most $\frac{2}{\pi}\arcsin(\rho)+\frac{C}{\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\sqrt{2m+1}}$.
hypotheses_covered: There exists a real constant $C$ with $C>0$
